versions.changelog: Add public URL safety checks before external fetches and search-result ingestion to reduce SSRF risk.
Add experiment-directory ingestion with recursive csv, tsv, and json result artifact discovery.
Add dedicated fairness review and complete the evidence-first workflow product release.
Add multi-artifact fusion and metric normalization for stronger experiment evidence packaging.
Add direct csv/json result-artifact ingestion for lower-friction project evidence onboarding.
Add reviewed primary-source summaries for stronger research-level evidence grounding.
Bundle helper scripts inside the skill package and add explicit upstream source metadata.
Topic-first evidence workflow, external-source verification, and structured result-artifact ingestion.
Add a unified evidence pipeline runner and document the end-to-end workflow.
Tighten evidence classification and claim matching to reduce false confidence in draft automation.
Add evidence ledger generation, claim map bootstrap, and evidence gap triage helpers.
Add OpenClaw-specific evidence playbook, gap triage, and experiment gap report support.
First public release of Sopaper Evidence.
